official.deadline_note: The Ministry states 'The opening date for the scholarship application program is determined according to the requirements of the academic year at universities', so there is no single central closing date.
official.application_cycle: Set per academic year by each participating university; the Ministry's official Study in Saudi platform publishes semester-based application windows
official.status_note: The Ministry page presents the programme as open to applicants from all countries of the world, with the application route through the individual Saudi public university, the Saudi Cultural Attaché, or the Saudi Embassy.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Ministry states the Kingdom provides sponsorship for scholarship students 'free of charge and without tuition fees', and that type A scholarships are free scholarships in which the student gets full benefits.
benefits: Tuition-free study: the Kingdom provides sponsorship for scholarship students free of charge and without tuition fees
Health care for the student and family members who reside with him, where regulations require
Housing, where the institution grants it
Annual travel tickets, taking into account the regulations that govern them
The advantages enjoyed by fellow students of the educational institution
eligibility: Be a non-Saudi national, either from outside the Kingdom (external scholarship) or residing in the Kingdom with legal residency (internal scholarship)
Meet the admission requirements applicable to Saudi students in institutions of higher education
Age not less than 17 and not more than 25 for undergraduate study and the Arabic language teaching institute, 30 for a master's degree, and 35 for a doctoral degree
Where the applicant's own country requires government approval for study in the Kingdom, that approval must be obtained
Not hold another scholarship from an educational institution in the Kingdom
Not have been dismissed from any educational institution in the Kingdom
Present a certificate of absence of precedents from the security services of the applicant's country
Pass the medical examination determined by the regulations and instructions
Have certificates and supporting papers attested by the competent authorities specified by the educational institution
Have a mahram with the student, per the governing instructions, where the student is covered by a scholarship or has regular residence or is on an employer's register
For internal scholarships, obtain approval from whoever the student is registered to and be a regular resident of the Kingdom
requirements: Apply through the chosen Saudi public university for a programme open to international scholarship students; health and medical specialties are excluded at the post-secondary stage
Apply through the Saudi Cultural Attaché in your country, or the Embassy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia where no Cultural Attaché exists
Hold a scholarship from a Saudi university in order to obtain a study visa from Saudi embassies

To obtain a study visa you must have a scholarship from a Saudi university; after arrival, scholarship recipients may obtain a free residence permit for the duration of their study with a letter issued by the passport department of the admitting university
documents: Attested academic certificates and supporting papers
Certificate of absence of precedents from the security services of the country of nationality
Admission application to the chosen Saudi public university
selection_criteria: Admission follows the same conditions and controls as for Saudi students at the institution
The educational institution council sets the executive rules governing admission of scholarship students
The institution may require a recommendation from one of the bodies, institutions or personalities it specifies
coverage: Tuition-free study at Saudi public universities, described by the Ministry as sponsorship free of charge and without tuition fees
Health care, a financial reward upon arrival, housing, annual travel tickets and the other advantages enjoyed by fellow students, as set out for external scholarships
application_method: Apply to the Saudi public university of your choice through its own website and admission window
Apply to the Saudi Cultural Attaché in your country
If there is no Saudi Cultural Attaché in your country, apply to the Embassy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Use the Ministry's official Study in Saudi platform for the central application route
official.application_route: Apply directly to a Saudi public university during its own admission window, or through the Saudi Cultural Attaché or Saudi Embassy in your country.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to non-Saudi nationals: external scholarships for non-Saudi students from outside the Kingdom and internal scholarships for non-Saudi students residing in the Kingdom with legal residency.
official.international_eligibility: Yes, this is an international scholarship open to students from all countries of the world, with competitive selection among applicants from more than 200 countries.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: All available specialisations except health and medical specialties at the post-secondary stage, across Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers, Bachelor, Higher Diploma, Master's and PhD.
official.research_requirement: Not published as a separate scholarship requirement; admission is governed by the institution's own requirements and any recommendation it requires.
official.duration: Programme length follows the degree studied: Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers, Bachelor, Higher Diploma, Master's or PhD
official.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Education provides scholarships to attract distinguished international students in theoretical, scientific and research disciplines to study at its 27 public universities, with applicants applying through the university itself, the Saudi Cultural Attaché, or the Saudi Embassy. Awards are classified as external scholarships for students from outside the Kingdom or internal scholarships for non-Saudis holding legal residence, and are granted at three benefit levels set by each institution.

not_confirmed: funding_amount, funding_currency and funding_period - the Ministry publishes no monetary figure for the scholarship, the arrival reward, or the travel tickets
deadline_central - the Ministry states the opening date is set by the academic year requirements of each university, so no central closing date is published
english_requirement - no English test or score is published on the Ministry page; individual universities set their own language requirements
the exact monthly stipend and housing allowance values, and which of the three benefit levels each participating university currently offers
verification.notes: All eligibility conditions, age limits, the three scholarship benefit types (A full, B partial, C paid grant), the external scholarship advantages, the application routes, the study visa and residence permit rules, and the 27 public universities were read directly from the Ministry of Education's own Scholarships in Public Universities page.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no central application form, so your real deadline is whichever university you target, and that window can differ by months between institutions. The headline benefit is tuition-free study plus an arrival payment, housing and annual tickets, but the Ministry splits awards into type A full scholarships, type B partial scholarships offering only a seat or a seat plus housing, and type C paid grants, so confirm which level your institution is actually offering before you decline other funding. Health and medical specialties are excluded at the postgraduate stage, which eliminates a large share of the programmes most international applicants would otherwise target.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Saudi applicants aged 17 to 35 who want a tuition-free degree at a Saudi public university and can navigate a university-specific admission window rather than a central portal.
application_readiness_checklist: Identify the specific Saudi public university and programme first, then find that university's own admission window and deadline, since the Ministry does not set one
Have your academic certificates and supporting papers attested by the competent authorities named by the institution before you apply
Request the certificate of absence of precedents from your own country's security services early, since it is a required document and often slow to obtain
Book the medical examination required by the regulations and keep the result with your file
Confirm with the university or Cultural Attaché which benefit level (A, B or C) is on offer for your programme, since it determines whether housing is included
If your own government must approve study in the Kingdom, obtain that approval before submitting
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a health or medical specialty at the post-secondary stage, which is excluded
Falling outside the age limits: 25 for undergraduate or the Arabic language institute, 30 for master's, 35 for doctoral
Submitting unattested certificates or supporting papers, which the institution will not accept
Missing the individual university's own admission window while waiting for a central deadline that does not exist
Holding another scholarship from a Saudi educational institution, or having previously been dismissed from one
Assuming a type B seat-only award will include housing, when it may not
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Under a type B partial scholarship or type C paid grant, part or all of your tuition, plus living costs beyond the arrival reward and any housing provided. Even under a type A award, personal expenses, travel beyond the annual ticket and family costs beyond the regulated health care are not covered.
document_audit: Certificates and supporting papers must be attested by the competent authorities specified by the educational institution, so check which authorities that institution accepts before paying for attestation
The certificate of absence of precedents must come from your own country's security services, not a local police station equivalent
You need a scholarship from a Saudi university before you can obtain a study visa, so the admission decision is the gating step for travel
Female students covered by a scholarship or regular residence must comply with the mahram rules as set by the governing instructions
alerts: Because each university sets its own opening date, the practical deadline varies and can be unknown until the university publishes it
The three benefit levels are decided by the institution council, so the same programme can be full, partial or paid at different universities
The free residence permit is issued only after arrival, with a letter from the admitting university's passport department, so build that step into your travel planning
Health and medical specialisations are excluded at the post-secondary stage, so check the exclusion before choosing a field
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to a Saudi public university during its own admission window, or lodge the application through the Saudi Cultural Attaché or the Saudi Embassy where no Attaché exists, then use the university's admission decision to obtain a study visa and, after arrival, a free residence permit.
